title: Digital Clock: offer button to add time zones to the widget popup itself
line: The clock popup's Time Zones section has a new button that opens the clock settings straight on the Time Zones page.
explanation: The Time Zones section of the clock popup only offered "Switch…" for the systemwide time zone; adding or removing the zones listed there meant right-clicking the clock, opening its settings and finding the Time Zones page. Plasma also had no way for an applet to open its settings on a page other than the first. libplasma gains Applet::showConfigurationPage(), which opens the settings and asks the dialog to show a given page; the settings dialog in plasma-desktop switches to that page (also when already open); the clock popup's Time Zones header gets a "+" button that uses it.

commits.message:
applet: add a way to open the configuration on a given page

Applets could only open their configuration dialog on its first page, so
a button in an applet's popup could not take the user straight to the
page it is about. showConfigurationPage() opens the dialog on that page.

CCBUG: 508194

desktoppackage: open the applet configuration page that was requested

When an applet asks for a specific page of its configuration dialog, the
dialog now switches to that page, both when it is first opened and when
it was already open on another page.

CCBUG: 508194

applets/digital-clock: add a button to add or remove time zones

Changing the time zones shown in the popup meant opening the settings
and finding the right page. The Time Zones header in the popup now has a
button that opens the settings directly on the Time Zones page.

BUG: 508194

patches.diff:
From cabda809997cf844ed986e857c267d049abb98d1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 17:04:42 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applet: add a way to open the configuration on a given page

Applets could only open their configuration dialog on its first page, so
a button in an applet's popup could not take the user straight to the
page it is about. showConfigurationPage() opens the dialog on that page.

CCBUG: 508194
---
 src/plasma/applet.cpp | 11 +++++++++++
 src/plasma/applet.h   | 17 +++++++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 28 insertions(+)

diff --git a/src/plasma/applet.cpp b/src/plasma/applet.cpp
index dd2a9f667..f85bc3835 100644
--- a/src/plasma/applet.cpp
+++ b/src/plasma/applet.cpp
@@ -664,6 +664,17 @@ QAction *Applet::internalAction(const QString &name) const
     return d->actions.value(name);
 }
 
+void Applet::showConfigurationPage(const QString &source)
+{
+    QAction *configAction = d->actions.value(QStringLiteral("configure"));
+    if (!configAction || !configAction->isEnabled()) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    configAction->trigger();
+    Q_EMIT configurationPageRequested(source);
+}
+
 void Applet::removeInternalAction(const QString &name)
 {
     QAction *action = d->actions.value(name);
diff --git a/src/plasma/applet.h b/src/plasma/applet.h
index 5545988fc..d61890b4a 100644
--- a/src/plasma/applet.h
+++ b/src/plasma/applet.h
@@ -634,6 +634,16 @@ public:
      */
     Q_INVOKABLE void removeInternalAction(const QString &name);
 
+    /*!
+     * Shows the configuration interface of this applet, opened on the page
+     * whose source file is \a source (for example "configGeneral.qml").
+     * Does nothing if the applet can't be configured right now.
+     *
+     * \sa configurationPageRequested
+     * \since 6.9
+     */
+    Q_INVOKABLE void showConfigurationPage(const QString &source);
+
     /*!
      * Returnss All the internal actions such as configure, remove, alternatives etc
      */
@@ -807,6 +817,13 @@ Q_SIGNALS:
      */
     void configurationRequiredChanged(bool needsConfig, const QString &reason);
 
+    /*!
+     * Emitted when showConfigurationPage was called, after the configuration
+     * interface was requested, so that it can switch to the \a source page
+     * \since 6.9
+     */
+    void configurationPageRequested(const QString &source);
+
     /*!
      * Emitted when the applet gains or loses the ability to show a configuration interface
      * \sa hasConfigurationInterface
-- 
2.53.0

From 63ba7dec9b8ada2d15185500abcf0b8b7a80972a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 17:04:43 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/digital-clock: add a button to add or remove time
 zones

Changing the time zones shown in the popup meant opening the settings
and finding the right page. The Time Zones header in the popup now has a
button that opens the settings directly on the Time Zones page.

BUG: 508194
---
 applets/digital-clock/CalendarView.qml | 21 +++++++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 21 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/CalendarView.qml b/applets/digital-clock/CalendarView.qml
index 48d5dcccb7..b191a325ed 100644
--- a/applets/digital-clock/CalendarView.qml
+++ b/applets/digital-clock/CalendarView.qml
@@ -451,6 +451,27 @@ PlasmaExtras.Representation {
                         text: parent.Accessible.description
                     }
                 }
+
+                PlasmaComponents.ToolButton {
+                    id: configureTimeZonesButton
+
+                    visible: Plasmoid.internalAction("configure").enabled
+                    display: PlasmaComponents.AbstractButton.IconOnly
+                    text: i18n("Add or Remove Time Zones…")
+                    icon.name: "list-add"
+
+                    KeyNavigation.left: switchTimeZoneButton
+                    KeyNavigation.down: clocksList
+                    Keys.onRightPressed: event => {
+                        monthView.Keys.downPressed(event);
+                    }
+
+                    onClicked: Plasmoid.showConfigurationPage("configTimeZones.qml")
+
+                    PlasmaComponents.ToolTip {
+                        text: configureTimeZonesButton.text
+                    }
+                }
             }
         }
 
-- 
2.53.0
